sentences.text: Akhtar Beg Ayyub Beg vs The State Of Maharashtra on 26
August, 2021

Author: Bharati Dangre
Bench: Bharati Dangre
 1/3 22 ABA-1566-21.doc
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.1566 Of 2021
Akhtar Beg Ayyub Beg .. Applicant
 Versus
The State of Maharashtra .. Respondent
 ...

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr.Shailesh Chavan i/b Mr.Milind Deshmukh for the
Applicant.
Mr.S.S.Pednekar, App for the State.
Psi Amit Sid-Patil attached to Local Branch, Solapur present.

... 
 Coram: Bharati Dangre, J.
Dated : 26th August, 2021 P.C:-
1.

The applicant is admitted to the interim protection by order dated 15/07/2021 in C.R.No.626 of 2021 registered with Sangola Police Station, which invoke Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short, "IPC")
and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Recording that the details of the goods i.e. its origin and destination is already disclosed by the driver,
who has been released on bail and considering that at this stage, no custodial interrogation is warranted, the applicant was directed to be released on interim bail.
2.

On the last date of hearing, learned APP has pointed out that there are four CRs registered against the present applicant, which indicated his involvement in the prohibited M.M.Salgaonkar 2/3 22 ABA-1566-21.doc substance.

The CRs are of recent time which indicate that the applicant is involved constantly in the said activity of bringing the prohibited substance in the State of Maharashtra, as per the direction of the Commissioner of Food Safety vide the relevant notifcations issued and he is habituated of selling the said material in the State of Maharashtra.

entities.text: Akhtar Beg Ayyub Beg vs The State Of Maharashtra on 26 August, 2021 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned APP has also placed on record a charge-sheet fled in C.R.No.223 of 2020 where the applicant is charged with bringing the prohibited substance from Karnataka in the State of Maharashtra and indulging into a conspiracy with the other accused persons in selling the said prohibited substance.
M.M.Salgaonkar  3/3 22 ABA-1566-21.doc 4.

On noting that one offence is of the year 2019 and three other offences registered in District Aurangabad and Jalna pertain to the 2020, reveal the continuous activity of the applicant in bringing the prohibited substance in the State of Maharashtra and fruther dealing in the same.

When there is a prohibition on substance of either being sold, purchased, transported or consumed,
the applicant's custody is necessary for further investigation as to on how many occasions, he had brought the substance in the State in contravention of the notifcation of the State.
The accusations need to be viewed seriously as on previous four occasions, the applicant has indulged in the similar activity.

sentences.text:
2 In such circumstances, the interim protection in favour of the applicant, granted on 15/07/2021,
stands vacated and application stands rejected.

( SMT. BHARATI DANGRE, J.) M.M.Salgaonkar Akhtar Beg Ayyub Beg vs The State Of Maharashtra on 26 August, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164424070/
